item.title: Andros Bridge, BPL Outages, Child Stealing Case
item.ns0:title: Andros Bridge, BPL Outages, Child Stealing Case
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, a vital lifeline in Central Andros is severed as structural failures force the emergency closure of the Fresh Creek Bridge. Energy officials address the ongoing power crisis and the strain of record-breaking heat as they explain the evolving roles of BPL and the Bahamas Grid Company. We take you inside the courtroom for major developments in a high-profile child stealing case and the legal fallout from a tragic dog mauling in Bimini. Plus, a new digital asset marketplace aims to restore confidence in the sector, and we follow Team Bahamas on their quest for World Cup glory.
